notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone, Today we have some amazing things to share with you![/h3]

[b]We added German voice-over to the game featuring original Guybrush voice actor Norman Matt![/b]

In addition to that, there were some minor bug fixes

notes.title: The Fastest Selling Monkey Island - Now With a Native Linux Build!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585659/76b09c39fb759cc7374f684726a7ae36a6e781d7.png[/img]

Thanks to you, loyal customers, Return to Monkey Island is now the fastest-selling Monkey Island game EVER! At least, I think so. My sales data is a little "fuzzy." But let's go with it!

Coinciding with this news, the ol' team at Terrible Toybox launched a brand new build delivering the much anticipated native Linux build. 

Catch ya later. Enjoy.
Stan

[h3]Update 1.3.5 Changelog[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Native Linux
[*] Fix for breather timer being incorrect
[*] Fix for Trivia cards not appearing correctly
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.3
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! New patch is here![/h3]

[list]
[*] Trivia card fix for players that couldn’t get the last card.
[*] Fixed a key rebinding issue relating to the middle mouse button
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone! Got a new patch with new fixes check it down bellow! [/h2]

[list]
[*] Possible for fix for mouse events when using a controller.
[*] Fix for red flash on MacBook Pro 13 inch.
Set pref: [i]metalCompatibilityFloat16ColorBuffer: 1[/i]
[*] Changed graphics card support message.
[*] Offline Steam achievements.
[*] Small game bug fixes.
[*] Fixes for Translation typos and other text.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello! We are continuing with bug fixes![/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed sleeping Windows and a controller.
[*] Performance and stability improvements on low-end machines.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]


Have an amazing day and thank you for your patience and understanding!

notes.title: Patch notes 1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Hello! Here is a small patch to fix some of the issues that you encountered on release. We are still going through reports and working on fixing them all out! [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed sleeping Windows and a controller.
[*] Performance and stability improvements on low-end machines.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and understanding!
